summary: Two messages in seven days, both ALTR-side, and the client has now been silent for 17 days. Michelle posted the leak-removal breakdown on Aug 25 (third consecutive week) and Stephski finally chased payment on Aug 26 — 11 days after the extension deadline she herself set lapsed on Aug 15, and four days after the second invoice came due. Nothing else happened on this account. Both invoices are now overdue at the same time, which has never happened before: the July 15-31 invoice is 27 days from send, 20 days past its original Aug 8 due date and 13 days past the extension; the combined Aug 15 invoice (July balance + Aug 1-14, the largest bill of the relationship) hit its ~Aug 22 due date unpaid, unacknowledged and unchased. Last week's report predicted exactly this and named checking that Aug 22 due date as the first job of the week; it was missed by four days. It also named off-thread contact as the single most important action — there is no evidence any was made, and the Aug 26 chase went out in the Invoicing topic, the exact channel Chey has already told us she does not see ('Oh I didn't even see this was for 2nd of August! I'm so sorry'). The chase itself was one line, no escalation, no phone call to the number Stephski gave her on Jul 1, no pause-of-work decision. On delivery, the Promo topic has had nothing since Derrek's Aug 1 phone-farm post (27 days) and Social Media nothing since Jul 29 (30 days) — a fourth consecutive week of zero IG output while two billing periods sit unpaid. Vivek, introduced as the Meta Support rep on Jul 29, has still never posted a single message, 30 days on. Derrek has not spoken to this client in 27 days; Mayson in 36. The only person who has done anything visible for her all month is Michelle. This account is not stalling, it is closing.

Four things moved it: (1) the exposure doubled — the combined Aug 15 invoice passed its ~Aug 22 due date unpaid, so for the first time in the relationship two invoices are overdue simultaneously, one of them 27 days from send; (2) client silence extended from 10 days to 17, and she did not respond to the Aug 26 chase either, so the non-response streak now spans two separate chases; (3) last week's two headline recommendations — contact her off-thread immediately, and check the Aug 22 due date first thing — were not actioned; the only chase was 11 days late and went to the Invoicing topic she has already said she misses; (4) IG/promo is in its fourth silent week, 27 days past Derrek's promised update, with Vivek 30 days introduced and still silent. Held off a steeper drop by two things: Stephski did eventually resume chasing on Aug 26, and Michelle delivered the leak-removal report for the third straight week — she is the only person on this account with an unbroken delivery record.
